title: Data Scientist
description:
What Exactly Should You Look For? Core Expertise: Python, Machine Learning, Time-Series Modelling, and Numerical Optimisation. Preferred Industry Background: Manufacturing, Metals, Mining, Cement, Chemicals, Oil & Gas, and other Process Industries. A. Strong Python & Machine Learning Expertise Must-have skills: Strong proficiency in Python programming. Experience in Machine Learning model development. Hands-on experience with LightGBM. Knowledge of GAM (Generalized Additive Models). Feature engineering. Model validation and diagnostics. Model explainability. What to look for: The candidate should be capable of reviewing existing ML models, identifying areas for improvement, and optimising their performance rather than building everything from scratch. B. Time-Series & Industrial Process Modelling This is one of the most important aspects of the requirement. Must-have expertise: Time-series forecasting and modelling. Industrial process data analysis. Equipment performance modelling. Experience working with historian data and laboratory data. Understanding of lagged features and sensor data. Knowledge of process variables and operational parameters. Predictive modelling for manufacturing operations. What does this mean practically? The candidate should understand how different industrial variables interact and develop models that can predict final outcomes based on historical and real-time operational data. C. Constrained Numerical Optimisation Relevant skills: Numerical optimisation. Constrained optimisation. Metaheuristic algorithms. Grid Search. Optimisation of operating parameters. Multi-objective optimisation. Throughput, recovery, and cost optimisation. Sensitivity and scenario analysis. What to look for: Candidates should have experience developing optimisation approaches that identify the best operating parameters while considering industrial constraints, production targets, recovery rates, and operational costs. D. Industrial Domain Experience Preferred industry backgrounds: Manufacturing. Mining and Metals. Cement. Chemicals and Petrochemicals. Oil & Gas. Power and Energy. Industrial Automation. Relevant experience: Working with process engineers, plant operators, operational SMEs, and industrial data. Understanding industrial processes and operational parameters. Experience in manufacturing optimisation or process optimisation. Candidates with direct experience in industrial or process optimisation would be particularly relevant. E. Model Pipeline & Live Testing Look for candidates who have hands-on experience with: Machine Learning model pipelines. Model deployment and inference workflows. Kedro (QuantumBlack) desirable, but not mandatory. API integration and data exchange. Live model validation. Shadow testing. Model monitoring and feedback loops. What to look for: The candidate should be comfortable running predictions on live plant data, comparing predicted outcomes with actual results, validating model performance, and improving models through continuous monitoring and feedback. Key Hiring Priority The ideal candidate should combine three major capabilities: Machine Learning: Strong Python, LightGBM, GAM, feature engineering, and model diagnostics. Industrial Modelling & Optimisation: Time-series modelling, process data understanding, and constrained numerical optimisation. Practical Implementation: Model pipelines, deployment, live plant data validation, and shadow testing. Important: Prioritise candidates who have applied Machine Learning and optimisation to real industrial processes rather than candidates with only theoretical ML or general data science experience.

Key Skills: Machine,Data modeling,Python,Time series analysis,Optimization,Gam,Modeling,Analysis

title: AI Data Scientist
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a motivated AI Data Scientist to join Deltek s growing AI Center of Excellence team to design, build, evaluate, and optimize enterprise AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multimodal AI, open-source AI models, and emerging foundation model technologies. This role is focused exclusively on AI innovation and implementation rather than traditional analytics or reporting. The ideal candidate will develop intelligent AI systems, evaluate model performance, build agentic workflows, and contribute to the adoption of AI-powered business solutions, working with guidance from senior team members on larger or more complex initiatives. The successful candidate combines solid expertise in Generative AI, machine learning, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation with a passion for translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into scalable business outcomes. This role reports to the Senior Director, AI Solutions. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Generative AI Solution Development 
 Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions for defined use cases, following established architecture patterns. Build AI applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and SLMs. Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking, embedding, retrieval, and re-ranking. Implement conversational AI, AI copilots, and intelligent assistants. Design and refine prompt engineering strategies. Contribute to multimodal AI solutions involving text, image, audio, and document understanding. 
 
 Agentic AI Autonomous Systems 
 Develop AI Agents capable of reasoning and task execution for well-defined business workflows. Build components of multi-agent frameworks and agent orchestration solutions. Develop automated workflows integrating enterprise systems and business processes. Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and agent memory patterns. Tune agent planning, reasoning, and decision-making behavior based on test results and feedback. 
 
 AI Model Evaluation Optimization 
 Apply and extend evaluation frameworks for AI solutions. Build benchmarks and test sets for quality, accuracy, groundedness, hallucination detection, and safety. Evaluate and compare foundation models for business use cases and share findings with the team. Improve AI system performance through prompt tuning, fine-tuning, and model optimization. Monitor AI solution effectiveness and recommend enhancements. 
 
 AI Engineering Deployment 
 Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy AI solutions into production environments. Build AI pipelines and support inference architectures. Support integration of AI services with enterprise applications and workflows. Partner with platform teams to improve AI cost, latency, scalability, and performance. Implement AI observability, monitoring, and governance controls as defined by the team. 
 
 Responsible AI Governance 
 Apply Responsible AI principles throughout the AI lifecycle. Evaluate solutions for bias, fairness, explainability, security, and compliance. Support AI governance policies, risk assessments, and model validation processes. Implement safeguards and guardrails for enterprise AI applications. 
 
 AI Innovation Research 
 Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, foundation models, open-source AI, and agentic systems. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and share recommendations with the team. Create proof-of-concepts and pilot solutions using next-generation AI capabilities. Contribute to enterprise AI strategy and AI capability development.
